notes: Subject-object insert through subgroup_of (transitive). 'A subgroup is a subset' and 'a subgroup of a cyclic group is cyclic' are firm rules. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

fol.notes: Lagrange's theorem instantiated at the pair the question asks about. 'Could ... have 5 elements?' is a consistency question.

lagrange.says: The order of every subgroup of a finite group divides the order of the group.
lagrange.z3: All([h, g], [(varnick, ostley)], Implies(And(subgroup_of(h, g), finite(g)), order(g) % order(h) == 0))

ostley_12.says: The Ostley group is finite and has 12 elements.
